A place that you don’t wanna miss and if you come once you’ll keep coming back
Jul 2024 • Family
Absolutely hidden gem in side streets of Nha Trang ♥️ Fantastic little place that serves both breakfast: home made yogurt with fruit or oats, croissants , omelets, avocado on rye bread and lunch/dinner: pizza, pasta, fish and chips and butter grilled lobster…everything fresh and mouth-watering.
In addition to that they make delicious fresh made juices and smoothies. Owners are locals that have been living in Switzerland for many years and are speaking very good English. They are very kind and warm people. 
This is definitely a place that you don’t wanna miss and if you come once you’ll keep coming back 🥰
P.S. Food was so good that we remembered to take a picture first when we were almost done ☺️🙈
